sloka: तद्दैवतबलं राम हन्यमानं निशाचरैः ।प्रणुन्नं सर्वतो दिग्भ्यः सिंहनुन्ना मृगा इव ।। ७.२७.३३ ॥
transliteration: taddaivatabalaṁ rāma hanyamānaṁ niśācaraiḥ ।praṇunnaṁ sarvato digbhyaḥ siṁhanunnā mṛgā iva ।। 7.27.33 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, that army of gods, being killed by the night-wanderers, was driven away from all directions, just like deer are scattered by lions.
